name: The Feasting Season
description: The future shortens and shrinks as the Lord of the Feast stirs. Storehouses are cracked open, fields lie fallow, and soldiers help themselves to whatever is in reach. It is a time of indulgence and war.

choices.name: The Lord of the Feast
choices.description: The Lord of the Feast imbues target heroes and rulers with Feyblood, which empowers them and makes them more aggressive and gold-hungry. Feyblood will naturally trickle down to vassals if it targets a ruler, and the Prepare Spoils power can be used to guide along who they invade. Feyblood characters are not inherently aligned to you, and tend to grow in power, so it is important to make sure they remain corrupted by other means.
